messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: zero inflated poisson/negative binomial
parts:
Hi,

Can somebody help how to generate predictive posterior for zero inflated family.  I am not familiar how because of this sampling construct:
if (y[n] == 0)
  increment_log_prob(log_sum_exp(bernoulli_log(1,theta),
    bernoulli_log(0,theta)
    + poisson_log(y[n],lambda)));
else
  increment_log_prob(bernoulli_log(0,theta)
    + poisson_log(y[n],lambda));

I am used to statements without if (8 schools example in BDA) when the predictive posterior estimation is quite straightforward.

Thank you,
Linas
T

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] zero inflated poisson/negative binomial
parts:
Think generatively.  i.e,

generated quantities {
  int x_ppc[N];

  for (n in 1:N) {
    if (bernoulli_rng(theta))
      x_ppc[n] <- 0;
    else
      x_ppc[n] <- poisson_rng(lambda);
  }
}
